svg.aria-label: Map of the Malabar coast of Kerala showing the seven and a half churches remembered as founded by St Thomas: Kodungallur, Palayur, Kottakkavu, Kokkamangalam, Niranam, Nilakkal and Kollam, with Thiruvithamcode as the half church, and Malayattoor, Kottayam and Pattanam
